Subset (the BCMP-and-below slice; middleware/pubsub/topology/bm_service and
the adin2111 driver are deliberately NOT vendored here — the driver already
lives in firmware/bm_spike/vendor/adin2111):
  bcmp/                all .c + .h incl. messages/ headers (13 sources:
                       bcmp, packet, heartbeat, neighbors, ping, info, time,
                       config, configuration, resource_discovery, dfu_core,
                       dfu_client, dfu_host)
  common/              bm_freertos.c bm_os.h util.[ch] ll.[ch] device.[ch]
                       timer_callback_handler.[ch] lib_state_machine.[ch]
                       bm_common_structs.h
  network/             l2.[ch] l2_policy.[ch] bm_lwip.c bm_ip.h
                       network_device.h network_frames.h
                       (bm_linux.c NOT vendored — POSIX backend)
  third_party/crc/     crc.h crc16.c crc32.c
  third_party/tinycbor/ src subset (parser/encoder/validation; json/pretty
                       convenience files omitted) + LICENSE (MIT)
                       + tinycbor_alloc.h

lwIP itself is NOT vendored: version 2.2.1 is referenced from the D23/D24
build env's openmv clone (lib/micropython/lib/lwip), same access pattern as
the Alif DFP sources. The FreeRTOS sys_arch glue is vendored separately at
../lwip_contrib (see its PROVENANCE.txt).
